newsitem.title: USA: Citizens to eliminate class A shares.
newsitem.headline: Citizens to eliminate class A shares.

text.p: Citizens Utilities Co said Wednesday that on August 25 its series A common stock will be converted into series B common stock, resulting in a single class of common stock, Citizens series B.
The company said it will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol CZN.N.
Citizens added that that the company's dividend policy will remain unchanged after the conversion.
Citizens provides telecommunications and public utility services to approximately 1.6 million customers in 22 states.
